$comment: The capability vocabulary (platform plan 3.2): one list, used by nodes, packages, and integrations alike. A package's manifest.requires/optional and a Device's capabilities both draw from this list. Not to be confused with the robot's 20-item capability GRANT list (3.1), which is a later (Hub v0.3 / robot authorization) addition, out of spec v0.1 scope. The engine roles (vision, image, video, music, stt, tts) are named exactly as the Stack's role ids so a manifest's requires and the hub's engine allocation share one list; the chat role maps to gpu_llm or cpu_llm and the embed role to embeddings (home/docs/plans/hardware-tiers-2026-09-23.md, Capabilities follow the allocation). The body ids (BODY-VOCAB-01) are what a robot body declares on its Device.capabilities row: head_6dof (head with six degrees of freedom), head_pan_tilt (head that pans and tilts only), roll (head roll), antennas (movable antennas), body_yaw (body rotation about the vertical axis), eyes (display or actuated eyes), mouth (display or actuated mouth), light_ring (addressable light ring), doa (direction-of-arrival from the mic array), state_feed (live joint and sensor state stream), encoders (joint position encoders), touch (touch sensing), distance (distance sensing), imu (inertial measurement unit), battery_readout (reports battery level), physical_mute (hardware mute switch), camera_shutter (physical camera shutter), moves_recorded (plays prerecorded moves), speech_pod (speech is placed on the pod), speech_robot (speech is placed on the robot itself). New observation capabilities: gestures (closed hand-gesture observations) and sound_events (closed on-body audio-event labels; vocabulary only, processing remains disabled until separately scheduled).
